pages.title: Computronium Block
pages.text: A block of matter arranged so that every atom is part of a computation. It is warm to the touch and very slightly noisy, as though it is always working. Computronium is the theoretical limit of programmable matter.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Once a self-improving mind made computronium possible, I compacted the ingots into blocks for building. The blocks keep thinking even when nothing is asking them to.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cognitive Singularity, Computronium Ingot, Computronium Lamp, Matrioshka Brain.
